headline: Profit growth cools to low single digits
summary_short: Chailease Holding's H1 2026 consolidated net income attributable to parent was NT$10.83B (H1 EPS NT$5.84), up about 3% y/y; Q2 standalone EPS of NT$2.65 rose 4.8% y/y but fell 18.7% q/q.
summary_long: H1 2026 consolidated net income attributable to parent was NT$10.83B, up roughly 3% y/y, with cumulative H1 EPS of NT$5.84 (no independently disclosed y/y comparison for the EPS figure itself). Q2 standalone EPS of NT$2.65 rose 4.8% y/y but fell 18.7% q/q. The fetched regulatory disclosure carries only the headline financial figures with no management commentary — no leasing-volume, credit-cost, or regional (Taiwan/China/Southeast Asia) breakdown was given, so the modest 3% growth is not explained in the release.
confidence_notes: No edgarCik; shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback.
